boucaniers.title: BOUCANIERS
boucaniers.tagline: Embark on a simultaneous treasure hunt!
boucaniers.description: Sail in a changing archipelago filled with cannibals, corrupt trading posts and voodoo mysteries. Arm your ship, recruit, plunder and trade while watching out for the East India Companies. The outcome is never certain and each turn gives you thrills!

simultaneous.title: Play simultaneously
simultaneous.description: Secret navigation with compass rose - Simultaneous actions (no waiting for turns)

fluid.title: Fluid mechanics
fluid.description: Dice combat system - Boarding and cannon fire

epic.title: An epic
epic.description: Two epic objectives: Armand's treasure or 25 gold pieces - The Rougeaud passage (15 bonus pieces!)

depth.title: Game depth
depth.description: Islands with unique actions - Infinite combos - Asymmetrical ships

playability.title: Playability and replayability
playability.description: Modular board (10 ships, 24 unique buccaneers) - Each game is unique

immersive.title: Immersive universe
immersive.description: Clues forming a continuous frieze - Hidden story of Armand the Storyteller

vincent.name: Vincent Tellier
vincent.description: Game and mechanics designer, illustrator, figurine modeler. History enthusiast.

thierry.name: Thierry Durand
thierry.description: Original idea designer, eternally unsatisfied, who strips the game of every flaw.

remi.name: Rémi Durand
remi.description: Figurine manufacturer. Seasoned and meticulous engineer. 3D printing expert, ensures manufacturing quality.
